name: safari_yards
description: Safari Zone regression, 0.7.0-alpha.20 ROUND rework (the Ridgewatch Preserve custody game — supersedes the Day Permit design AND absorbs the deleted safari_bait_fee.json, since the intake-concierge preset was pruned with the a20 re-cast and `safari bait` is now the only kiosk surface). Full round loop at the in-zone mew-wisp clearing [1300.5 89 1450.5]: badge gate (a20 adjudication: gateBadges 6, post-gym-6 leg) refuses untouched below 6, the NEW liberation gate (safari_liberated — Nova's turn-in is the single writer) refuses a badge-6 player inside the fence, the polygon gate refuses from outside the fence (Sango pond, verified stadium_wave/pay_probes ground) BEFORE any fee dispatch, a broke enter declines via the deferred #sf_ok pay-probe with custody untouched, then a funded `enter capture` charges the 500 CD round fee, takes the ENTIRE party + inventory into Preserve custody (sentinels: a givemon magikarp + a feebas last-partner guard + 3 diamonds vanish), and issues the marked kit — 10 Preserve Safari Balls + 16 snowballs + 6 bait (2 per standard table; the a20 lure retune runs THREE standard tables — honey_smear/dried_skewer/glimmer_grit — still_water_chum is deleted, the zone has no water). Stealth is REAL now: an exposed player spooks a lure in ~3s (3 seen-checks at 10t + 30t flee), so the lure beats run CONCEALED — a short_grass setblock at the feet + the client driver holding sneak (input.key) keeps alert at 0 for the whole window. dev scatter -> tagged ci_safari_lure -> dev befriend (friendly latch) -> dev spook (flee + 'spooked and bolted'). Kiosk rail folded in: `safari bait executive_blend` charges 250 CD via #sfb_ok one tick behind payment (funded: receipt + 1 marked gold_nugget; broke: branded actionbar + 'kiosk order didn't clear' + no issue). Voluntary exit ends in place (NO teleport — only the clock escort moves the player), sweeps every marked/bait item ('Round gear handed back'), restores custody exactly (diamonds return, monturnin proves the magikarp is back and removes it — the feebas guard keeps it off the a20 last-partner refusal), and sweeps the lures. The mid-round monturnin now asserts the NEW session-guard refusal ('hands are full mid-round') — it proves the safari session guard, not the emptied party; no other cheap rcon probe can see Cobblemon party emptiness, so custody-taking is proven by the diamond vanish + the post-exit hand-over instead. A compact CONTEST round then pins the second mode word + the 0-point appraisal + a second clean custody cycle. NO BATTLE BEAT BY DESIGN (BATTLE_STARTED_PRE cancelled at HIGHEST during rounds). NEEDLE RULE: Preserve lines are Component.literal with embedded § codes and HudLog stores getString() RAW — needles sit inside ONE color run or bridge runs with regex .*; parenthesised tails are trimmed off needles (wait_chat is regex). Post-state: badges 0 (wheat_war assumes badges<3), balance parked at 500 (safari-family ride-out), sentinel magikarp REMOVED by the restore-probe monturnin, diamonds cleared, safari_liberated + probe tags removed; residue: one short_grass block stays at [1300 89 1450] (cosmetic, in-theme, idempotent on re-runs) and the feebas guard stays ONLY on an empty-party driver (its cleanup monturnin refuses the last partner there — unasserted, in-theme, matches the house givemon precedent).

steps.comment: -- SITE + DESIGN NOTES: every safari command is rcon-dispatched via 'execute as {player}' (enter/exit/status are perm 0; bait/scatter/dev are perm 2 and come from the console side — execute-as keeps console perms AND source-visible sendSuccess, the dev-badges precedent). The dev hooks (scatter/dev befriend/dev spook) are the engine's OWN harness stand-ins: Carpet/driver players cannot fire UseBlockCallback bait clicks, offer bait via UseEntityCallback, or throw snowballs. KNOWN UNCOVERABLE HEADLESSLY: snowball weaken (projectile throw), the 180s clock-expiry escort (too slow for the suite), the boundary-grace countdown (no verified ground just outside the fence), the natural detection raycast as a POSITIVE spook (covered implicitly: any extra lure from the 1-3 roll bolts on its own once sneak releases), crash-file custody heal (needs a relog; the JOIN handler owns it), and the honey_smear TREE-PLACEMENT gate (a20: a real UseBlockCallback click on logs/leaves is required — wrong ground refuses with 'goes on bark' and consumes nothing; the dev scatter hook DELIBERATELY bypasses placement, so beat 5 only proves the honey table still scatters — the tree click itself is an IN-WORLD VERIFY item). --

-- STUCK-CUSTODY CAVEAT: a pending custody record with NO live session (scenario killed between fee-resolve and exit) makes enter refuse with 'Maya is still sorting your effects' — rcon CANNOT clear it; relog the driver client (the JOIN heal restores and unblocks). The preamble's safari exit only clears LIVE sessions. --

-- preamble: tp BEFORE any entity ops (kill silently no-ops in unloaded chunks). Site = 3b from the noble_giver_mew_wisp latch at 1300.5 64 1450.5 (compiled placement, live-swept grounded surface y89) inside the Safari Zone polygon x~1212-1552 / z~1344-1785 (install.json zones[60], 2D column test — any Y). Day + regen keep the hardcore run survivable; day-set also blocks a homestead-income rollover mid-run (exact-balance asserts). Zone flags now suppress hostiles AND NaturalSpawnGuard suppresses wild cobblemon inside the fence (a20) — the tag-keyed lure poll is doubly immune. --
-- stale-sneak defense: a prior aborted run can leave the driver's sneak key held (this file holds it through the lure beats); harmless no-op when already up --

-- reset (idempotent re-runs): stale battle (custody refuses mid-battle entries; stopbattle fires no event), stale session exit ('No round running' on clean runs is fine), stray lures, every item id this run counts (kit ids: safari_ball/snowball/honeycomb/bone/glowstone_dust + the exec-blend gold_nugget + the diamond sentinel — clearing them BEFORE the custody snapshot keeps every post-restore count exact; prismarine_crystals left the kit with still_water_chum), and the restore-probe tag --

steps.rcon: execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative safari exit

steps.comment: -- custody sentinels: two party mons (givemon — e2e_run's per-scenario ci_harness tag suppresses the nickname modal) + 3 diamonds. The magikarp is the party-restore witness: the post-exit 'hand over' proves it came back and removes it. The feebas is the a20 LAST-PARTNER GUARD: monturnin now refuses the sole party member, so the magikarp hand-over needs a second mon standing behind it whatever the driver's own party holds --

steps.rcon: execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative givemon magikarp level=5
execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative givemon feebas level=5

steps.comment: -- beat 1: the badge gate HOLDS (a20: gateBadges 6). 0 badges + 900 CD (kept under 1000 — cobbledollars query abbreviates >=1000, exact below): enter must refuse BEFORE the pay dispatch, balance and inventory untouched. Needle stops before the parenthesised '(you hold …)' tail — the count sits in its own §e run AND wait_chat is regex --

Then the tag goes on — from here the player passes badge+liberation and only geometry/fee gates remain --

execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative safari enter capture

CUSTODY: inventory vanishes (diamond gone), kit issued: exactly 10 marked balls, 16 snowballs, and the FULL 6 kit bait — 2x honeycomb + 2x bone + 2x glowstone_dust (baitPerTable of every loaded table except the kiosk-only executive_blend; the a20 data-driven kit). The mid-round monturnin now proves the a20 SESSION GUARD ('hands are full mid-round' — refused before any party scan); party emptiness itself has no other cheap rcon probe, so custody-taking rides the diamond vanish here + the magikarp hand-over after exit. Status pins the mode word in its own §6 run --

execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative monturnin magikarp sf_probe
execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative safari status

steps.comment: -- beat 5: CONCEALMENT then scatter. The a20 stealth engine spooks an exposed player's lure in ~3s (3 seen-checks / 10t, then a 30t bolt) — the old poll-at-+21s cadence would find a corpse window. Concealment = crouch + feet-or-eye block in the concealment set: setblock ONE short_grass at the feet [1300 89 1450] (non-colliding; replaces air on the verified surface; left in place — cosmetic, in-theme, idempotent) and hold sneak via the driver. Scatter lands at blockPosition().below() = the ground under the grass. The table is DELIBERATELY honey_smear THROUGH THE DEV HOOK: the hook bypasses the a20 tree-placement gate (a real click needs logs/leaves), so this beat asserts the honey table still rolls and spawns; the a20 ground-snap (walk down <=8 to air-above-solid) is a no-op on this flat clearing. The tree click itself = in-world verify (see design notes). Suspense 5-15s, then 1-3 spawns that linger 75s while alert stays 0 --

steps.rcon: execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative safari scatter honey_smear

steps.comment: -- beat 6: the dev hooks on the nearest tracked lure (<=16b — we stand at the scatter spot). befriend latches friendly (hearts + window bonus, detection off); spook targets the NEAREST lure — possibly the just-befriended one (devSpook clears friendly first), either way the flee path runs: 30t bolt then the poof line. Sneak releases after; any OTHER lure from the 1-3 roll then bolts on its own — harmless extra evidence of the natural detection path --

execute as {player} run cobblemon-initiative safari dev spook
